responsibility: This source file provides checking-mode selftests for typed_splay_tree.h. It exercises a typed wrapper around a splay tree by inserting, deleting, looking up, querying predecessor/successor and min/max, and traversing elements through foreach, validating the wrapper’s ordered-map semantics rather than implementing the data structure itself.
same_name_distinction: Contains only checking-mode selftests for the typed_splay_tree wrapper API, whereas gcc/typed-splay-tree.h carries the real template implementation of the wrapper and its splay-tree operations.
